An Unwelcome Charter
Stonegate's keepers identify the fragment as wyrm-tempered heartstone. Old forge records say it formed when a crowned dragon breathed willingly through the mountain Ward.
Three convoys vanished after carrying scale chisels, breath-glass and sealed Iron Laurel equipment into the hills. Cassian Vane's official report calls the tremors ordinary subsidence.
Keeper Dagna Flint
“Our ancestors wrote covenant, not conquest. Someone has been cutting apart an agreement.”

“Your charter ends at Greenveil. Leave dead dragons and living mountains to professionals.”

LOCKED
Recover three missing convoys. Their cargo lists scale chisels, breath-glass and heatproof chains—not ordinary mining equipment.

Voices Under Stone
LOCKED
The manifests bear an Iron Laurel seal over an older five-part crown. Dwarven marginalia calls the excavation a collection of the breath-debt. As the phrase is translated, Northwatch's signal mirrors flare with a distress call from the northern Ward.

The Fires of Flintwatch
LOCKED
Ward-powered constructs emerge chanting an oath in Draconic while orc laborers attack the chains holding their families. Keep Flintwatch standing and preserve the words.

Ghorak the Chainbreaker
LOCKED
Ghorak challenges the guild at the shattered lift. He claims the deep stone called every miner oathbreaker—and promised that the First would wake beneath a burning sky.

The Laurel Below
LOCKED
Ghorak's testimony exposes the Iron Laurel operation—and the name on its sealed objective: FIRST CROWN VAULT.
7
Descent to the Hollow Forge
LOCKED
Descend past reliefs showing dwarves and a crowned dragon building the forge together. Reach its heart before their ancient agreement is broken completely.
8
The Hollow Warden
LOCKED
The Warden calls every living faction an oathbreaker. Break its shell, recover the heartstone, and hear the warning it guarded for centuries.
